title: First Return in Seam Release
statement: Let $M$ be a machine, let $a$ be one of its states, and suppose a computation from $c$ starts in state $a$, runs for a positive number $T$ of steps to a configuration $c'$ in state $a$, and has no intermediate return to state $a$ at any time $t$ with $0<t<T$. Starting from the configuration obtained by renaming the state of $c$ to the left summand, the seam-release machine reaches the state-renamed version of $c'$ in the right summand after $T$ steps; at every time $t<T$, its state is not the right-summand copy of $a$.
